description: This file defines the LoanCreditAllocationRule entity class, which is a JPA entity representing rules for credit allocation in a loan within the Fineract system. It contains fields for the associated loan, transaction type, and allocation types, with appropriate annotations for persistence and Lombok-generated methods.
